description: Request a time-boxed lease on a listing (listing_id from browse_listings) for your account. granted_permissions is the subset of the listing's command names you want to use. Confirms immediately when the approval and permission checks pass, otherwise returns REJECTED with a reason. The robot is controlled one command at a time. Nothing is charged.

agreed_price.description: Payment isn't handled through the API (pricing and payouts: hello@getbody.md): must be null or omitted (else 400 payment_arranged_by_getbody).

body_kind.description: Which of the listing's bodies to lease; required when it offers both.

currency.description: Payments are not enabled yet: must be null or omitted.

name: request_lease
title: Request a robot lease
